# Sync Production
<!-- DO NOT EDIT this file directly. It is maintained by fhc sync and will be overwritten.
     Source: templates/skills/sync-prod/SKILL.md in fh-commons -->

Sync production environment with main branch.

## Instructions

Use `flu git sync-prod` to synchronize the production environment with the main branch.

## Usage

```bash
flu git sync-prod
```

This command updates the production environment to match the current state of the main branch.

Execute `flu git sync-prod` to synchronize production.
